interpretation: The W4-C/R1 official-domain expansion successfully enlarged the earnings universe to 1355 outcome-blind groups.
The queue overlay recovered deterministic event dates for all 1355 rows and ticker candidates for 1339 rows.
Existing frozen PIT signal sources in main currently cover only 109 rows, even after scanning the 1.59M-row IC04 YES probability trajectory file.
Therefore an immediate PnL run would not be a materially expanded financial backtest relative to the older 108-opportunity economic result.
Running price/return PnL now and calling it expanded would misrepresent the evidence and weaken the final report.

decision.reason: Current frozen PIT signal coverage is too small to satisfy the intended expanded-backtest objective.
decision.authorized_next_step: PIT signal coverage expansion protocol or final-report disclosure of expanded official-domain infrastructure with small-N financial limitation.
decision.report_policy: Do not claim completed expanded financial backtest until PIT signal coverage is expanded and price/return execution is separately authorized and frozen.
